issues.desc: Background says koala init currently hard-creates src/core, src/shells, and tests, but CHK-001/CHK-003 only scope the src starter files. Clarify whether default tests/ and tests/fixtures remain Koala-managed assets or should also become opt-in; otherwise the init filesystem contract and verify-entrypoints assertions can drift.

CHK-001 names --starter / --with-template for opt-in starter generation but does not define the CLI contract: are both spellings required aliases, and which one is canonical in help/README/output examples? Decide this before implementation to avoid mismatched docs and smoke coverage.
